description: This repository's own rules, on top of the shared preset KevinDeBenedetti/renovate-config (config:best-practices, the Monday window in Europe/Paris, the 3-day release age, the prek.toml hook revs, github-workflows pins left to its release job, labels).

customManagers.description: The oxlint version the prek hook installs (prek.toml additional_dependencies). It must equal package.json's (scripts/__tests__/version-pins.test.ts), so it moves in the same pull request: see the oxlint rule below.

packageRules.description: Bump the package.json range with the lockfile (overrides the preset's :pinDevDependencies): a range left at its old floor would make the prek oxlint pin differ from package.json.

The package.json overrides hold transitive dependencies at a patched floor of the major their parents accept: a new major (vite 6 → 8 under VitePress 1.x) would force it on parents that do not support it. Minors and patches still flow.
oxlint is pinned twice (package.json and the prek hook): one pull request moves both.

TypeScript 7 dropped the `typescript/lib/tsc` subpath from its package exports map, which vue-tsc still requires internally: bumping past 6.x breaks `bun run typecheck`. Re-allow once vue-tsc ships TS7 support.
